'''John Kaufeld''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 49 from Indianapolis, In. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 John also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 28 in Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs); finished 7 in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck).<ref name="dc99yj05_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105010700/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Gold 49 || Indianapolis, In || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Kaufeld is thanked in the credits of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] rulebook (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher sent him the draft rules in October 2000 for an outsider's view; he urged a card almanac.<ref name="jkd102600">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102600.html Design Diary, 26 October 2000], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001208002600/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102600.html Internet Archive]</ref>
